name: Vigil-Oceanus

civilization.name: The Tidekeepers
civilization.notes: An aquatic species that builds floating city-platforms and has developed sophisticated tidal prediction systems that border on precognition.

description: Vigil-Oceanus is a temperate oceanic world dotted with small volcanic island chains that serve as anchoring points for the Tidekeepers' floating cities. The seas are warm and clear in the shallows, deepening to a rich sapphire blue where the continental shelves drop away.

The atmosphere is clean and breathable, carrying the tang of salt and the distant calls of marine fauna. At night, the bioluminescent reefs cast a soft blue-green glow across the water's surface, creating the impression that the ocean itself is awake and watching.

The Tidekeepers have inhabited this world for over ten thousand years, developing a civilization built entirely on water. Their tidal computation arrays can predict oceanic movements with uncanny accuracy, and some xenoanthropologists believe this ability extends to a form of limited temporal perception.

First contact protocols are well-established, as the Tidekeepers are aware of and cautiously receptive to offworld visitors. Their helium-3 reserves and unique computational methods make diplomatic engagement highly valuable, though the Concord's insistence on ocean sovereignty complicates resource negotiations.
